newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil beggar burned by street child dies.
newsitem.headline: Brazil beggar burned by street child dies.

text.p: A beggar who was set on fire by a street child in Rio de Janeiro last week died of his injuries, a hospital spokeswoman said on Friday.
Jorge Paulo, 48, who was set on fire by a 15-year-old boy on June 19 while he was sleeping, suffered second and third-degree burns on 70 percent of his body.
The hospital spokeswoman said severe burns to the beggar's face had caused respiratory problems which finally led to his death Thursday.
Paulo is the fourth person to die in Brazil since mid-April after being deliberately set on fire.
